cohort: Pregnant women attending AVBRH OPD from May 2013 to September 2014.
finding: Sickle cell disease is associated with increased rates of preterm delivery, cesarean sections, and adverse fetal outcomes such as intrauterine death, low birth weight, and low Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in women with sickle cell trait (60%) compared to sickle cell disease (40%), while instrumental delivery occurred in 2.22% of the sickle cell trait group and 20% of the sickle cell disease group.
